title: The Last Delivery
summary: Take Bram's letters to Ilse at the Wayfarer camp up the north road. She'll explain the rest.
ask: Bram: Ilse runs a camp for new hunters up the north road. Take these letters to her, and she'll explain the rest.

steps.text: Leave the city through the High Gate
done: Hale: Got your licence? Good, go on through. It's not too dangerous out here near the city, but keep your eyes open.

steps.text: Take the letters to the Wayfarer camp up the north road

done: Ilse: You must be one of Bram's new hunters. He said he'd send someone. Have you got our letters?
Ilse: Thank you! We've been waiting a whole week for these.
Ilse: Here, take an ember from our fire. Carry it with you, and when you find a spot you'd like to live, place it there. That'll be your home.

steps.text: Place your Ember where you want your home
